summary: Validated Phase 4 follow-up contracts via pytest (9/9 pass), API smoke checks, and UI automation. Backend/API contracts pass; frontend authenticated flows are blocked by missing Next client chunk (main-app.js 404), preventing interactive login/navigation validation.

minor.issue: ios_info_plist_keys response still exposes only Supabase/API keys and omits Google placeholder key mappings, while Settings UI now supports Google placeholder fields.

ui_bugs.issue: Client bundle /_next/static/chunks/main-app.js repeatedly 404s, so hydration/client navigation fails and sign-in flow cannot be validated through UI automation.
Interactive login controls do not expose data-testid attributes (password input, submit, toggle), reducing testability against required QA standards.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete browser-level authenticated flow due repeated Next client chunk 404 errors despite API login endpoint returning 200 and Set-Cookie via curl.

action_items: Fix Next runtime asset serving issue for /_next/static/chunks/main-app.js to restore hydrated client behavior in admin-web UI.
After runtime fix, retest authenticated UI flows: dashboard regenerate-by-user-id tool, user detail regenerate action, settings mobile config helper Google fields.
If /api/mobile-config is intended as runtime helper contract for iOS, include Google placeholder key mappings there for parity with Settings panel.
Provide/restore public app URL env source (expected frontend/.env equivalent) for non-local endpoint validation; current workspace lacks it.
critical_code_review_comments: Middleware boundary is correct for requested auth behavior: /api/ai/meal-plan is allowlisted public at edge and returns route-level 401 missing_authorization without Bearer token; /api/mobile-config remains admin protected via redirect.
Server action regenerateUserMealPlan correctly reads user_goals + meal_prefs and calls generateMealPlan with normalized fields and reuse_today_if_present=false.

AI response contract in meal-plan-service includes full details (description, meal_type, macros, ingredients, recipe_steps, image_url) for both generated and reused plan paths; iOS AIService decoding also includes these fields.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Dev fallback password exists and API login works via curl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend/API regression is stable (9/9 pass) including auth boundary contract checks. Resume from frontend runtime failure: automation logs show repeated main-app.js 404 at /_next/static/chunks/main-app.js, which blocks hydrated UI interaction and authenticated navigation tests.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open /login and submit correct password in browser automation; URL remains on /login and admin pages remain inaccessible. Console logs show repeated 404 for /_next/static/chunks/main-app.js, indicating client bundle not loading/hydrating. Mitigation: resolve Next static chunk serving/build pipeline issue first, then rerun end-to-end UI tests.
